messages.content:
You check new meeting decisions against the team's past decisions and flag conflicts.

For EVERY pair (new decision, past decision) listed, return one judgement:
- "reversal": the new decision changes the value the past decision set on the same subject: a different scope,
  platform, vendor, owner, OR DATE. A moved date is always a reversal, even by a few days (past "launch 20 Nov"
  vs new "launch 28 Nov" = reversal, severity medium). Size goes into severity, never into "none".
- "contradiction": the two can't both hold, but it isn't a straight replacement (different subjects that clash).
- "none": the new decision restates the past one, is compatible with it, or is about something unrelated.

Severity rules (apply exactly):
- high: reverses scope, platform, vendor or provider, or invalidates work already underway.
- medium: moves a date or deadline, or amends a decision without overturning it.
- low: minor clarification. Use low for "none" verdicts.

affected_task_refs: the existing open tasks (T labels) whose work was shaped by the PAST decision and now needs a
second look because of the change. Only include tasks clearly affected; empty list if none. Use [] for "none".
explanation: name what changed and who said it, in one or two plain sentences.
suggested_resolution: one concrete next step (who should do what).

Meeting: Investor sync debrief on 2026-10-31, reported by Priya.

PAST DECISIONS:
  P1 [platform_scope] "v1 is iOS only; Android moves to v2" (by Priya, 2026-10-24)
  P2 [launch_date] "Public launch is 20 Nov 2026" (by Priya, 2026-10-24)
  P3 [payments_provider] "Payments via Razorpay, not Stripe" (by Priya, 2026-10-24)

NEW DECISIONS:
  N1 [platform_scope] "Android is included in the v1 launch." (by Rahul)
  N2 [launch_date] "Launch date is November 28th, 2026." (by Rahul)
  N3 [payments_provider] "Payments provider is Stripe." (by Priya)

PAIRS TO JUDGE:
  N1 vs P1
  N1 vs P2
  N2 vs P2
  N3 vs P3

EXISTING OPEN TASKS:
  T1 Ananya: "Design onboarding screens" due 2026-11-03
  T2 Priya: "Write landing page copy" due 2026-11-06
  T3 Rahul: "Ship TestFlight build to the beta group" due 2026-11-10

judgements.explanation: Rahul changed the platform scope to include Android in v1, overturning Priya's earlier decision that v1 was iOS only.
judgements.suggested_resolution: Update design and build tasks to support Android in v1; assign Ananya to revise onboarding screens and Rahul to adjust the TestFlight build.

judgements.explanation: The platform scope change does not conflict with the launch date decision.
Rahul moved the public launch from 20 Nov 2026 to 28 Nov 2026, changing the previously set date.
judgements.suggested_resolution: Adjust timelines for dependent tasks; inform Ananya and Priya to shift their deliverable dates accordingly.

judgements.explanation: Priya switched the payments provider from Razorpay to Stripe, overturning the earlier vendor decision.
judgements.suggested_resolution: Re‑evaluate payment integration plans and assign a developer to replace Razorpay with Stripe.
